currentParagraphText: “Ree!” she said, making Jake nod in understanding.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Ree!” she said, making Jake nod in understanding.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Fair enough, you go fly around a bit,” Jake didn’t argue as Sylphie decided to give Jake and the newly arrived god some space to talk in peace. In the meanwhile, she would fly around a bit outside and play. He knew that while Sylphie was borderline immune to the presence of gods, she still felt a bit uncomfortable around the god who’d brought him beer. Which, to be fair, all but a handful of beings in the entire multiverse did.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Right after Jake noticed the arrival of the god, Sylphie also reacted as her head perked up, and she looked around a bit frantically. Quickly, she realized who it was that had arrived as she jumped off Jake’s head with a small screech.
